subsystem.name: VehiclePhysics
subsystem.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle physics: input smoothing and gear selection, rigid-body velocity/angular-velocity integration, spatial-grid collision normal resolution, broadphase collision list building/filtering/draining, track-environment physics parameter initialization, per-car physics state construction, vehicle reset/clear, and qualifying tire-usage event encoding.

summary: Architecture proposal for the vehicle_physics scope. Collision handling is split between a spatial-grid feature normal solver (CollisionFeatureSolver at 0x0044C550) and a family of linked-list managers operating on 16-byte {head,tail,anchor,count} records: CollisionBroadphaseBuilder (0x00490EE0) for AABB subdivision, and CollisionObjectListManager (0x004B4B50/0x004B4E10/0x004B5630) for sorting, minimum-tolerance removal, draining to a global free pool and filtering. Per-frame control comes from VehicleInputController (0x00454DA0) whose accumulators feed the VehiclePhysicsIntegrator (0x00459AE0). TrackEnvironmentManager (0x004AF3A0) initializes clamped environment parameter profiles; CarPhysicsState (0x004B57F0) is the large per-car physics state constructor; F1CVehicle (0x004C6E80/0x004C79E0/0x004C7BF0) covers reset/clear/property-set; QualifyingTireUsageRecorder (0x004BC060) encodes qualifying tire-set events. All class identities are DERIVED/GUESS proposals on validated IR; owners are mostly UNKNOWN in the packet.

function_roles.role: Collision normal solver: queries the spatial grid for the feature at a2 and derives the oriented collision normal from the feature plane coefficients into a3; returns the grid query result.

Per-frame input processor: ramps throttle/brake/clutch/steering/handbrake accumulators (mode==2 passthrough), sign-aware steering return-to-center, and gear selection from the gear-flag ladder with neutral override.

Per-frame velocity/angular-velocity integrator: branches on the contact count at +0x50, integrates physics state, composes transforms, renders the sprite grid, and exchanges remote-vehicle state through the network packet codecs.
Broadphase collision list builder: allocates a pool AABB node, filters existing nodes, clips overlapping AABBs into subdivisions, re-links and partitions the list.

Track-environment physics parameter initializer: dispatches on the track-type selector at +0x3B40 to one of four profiles and initializes a dense run of clamped parameter slots plus a per-wheel 2x8 array.
Collision object-list processor: when enabled, re-sorts the four sub-lists, then removes every node within the +/-0.02 tolerance of the global minimum head value and dispatches the collected nodes.
Collision list drainer: moves every sub-list node into the global free pool (dword_8AB700 head/tail/count), stores the session timestamp, resets per-sub-list metadata and re-arms the enable flag.
Collision list filter: walks the active list, keeps nodes passing the compare/tolerance tests, and unlinks/replaces culled nodes into the output list.
Per-car physics state constructor: zeroes the leading and middle arrays, sets sentinel/default blocks, forwards to sub-initializers, and configures the QPC timer block.
Qualifying tire-usage event encoder: during a qualifying session advances the ring buffer and encodes tire set in-use/discard events with the session-time payload and tire-compound byte.
Vehicle reset for reinitialization: clears physics/UI/driver sub-structures, reassigns random AI drivers, invalidates the slot markers at +0x48A4/+0x48A8, and resets the force-feedback base.
Driver-info region clearer: zeroes the byte fields, writes -1 into six slot-marker dwords, and sets fixed sentinels (0x48B4 = -8388609, 0x48BC = 11).
Vehicle property setter: stores the argument into this[4651] (+0x48AC) and returns the stored value.

classes.name: CollisionFeatureSolver
classes.responsibility: Resolves the oriented collision normal for a query position from the spatial-grid collision feature's plane coefficients, writing it into the caller's output vector.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.responsibility: Generic doubly-linked node list: {head, tail, anchor/current, count} at offsets 0x0/0x4/0x8/0xC. The broadphase builder and collision-list managers operate on such records.

classes.name: CollisionNode
classes.responsibility: Node object for collision lists: value at +0x0, next link at +0x4 (also used as a float sort key), flag byte at +0x8, an unread dword at +0xC, and a distance/tolerance field at +0x370.

classes.name: CollisionBroadphaseBuilder
classes.responsibility: Builds/updates a broadphase AABB list: allocates a pool AABB node, clips overlapping AABBs into subdivisions via RectangleClipping, re-links and partitions the result list.

classes.name: CollisionObjectListManager
classes.responsibility: Manages the per-frame collision object lists: four 16-byte {head,tail,anchor,count} sub-list records at +0x70, an output list and an active list, a filter threshold, and the global free-pool protocol for recycled nodes.

classes.name: VehicleInputController
classes.responsibility: Per-frame vehicle input processor: ramps per-axis smoothed accumulators toward direct targets with mode==2 passthrough, sign-aware steering return-to-center, and gear selection from the gear-flag ladder with neutral overrides.

classes.name: VehiclePhysicsIntegrator
classes.responsibility: Per-frame velocity/angular-velocity integrator: reads physics coefficients and position/orientation/rotation state, branches on the contact count, integrates the physics state, composes transforms, renders the sprite grid and exchanges remote-vehicle state via the network packet codecs.

classes.name: TrackEnvironmentManager
classes.responsibility: Track-environment physics parameter container: the track-type selector at +0x3B40 dispatches to one of four profiles that initialize a dense run of clamped float parameter slots and a nested per-wheel 2x8 array (36-byte stride).

classes.name: CarPhysicsState
classes.responsibility: Large per-car physics state object (DWORD array up to this[998]): zeroed leading/middle arrays, sentinel and default blocks, sub-initializer forwards, and a QPC timer configuration block.

classes.name: QualifyingTireUsageRecorder
classes.responsibility: Records qualifying tire-usage ring-buffer events: during a qualifying session advances the ring buffer and encodes tire set in-use/discard events with a session-time payload and the tire-compound byte.

classes.name: F1CVehicle
classes.responsibility: The per-vehicle object. Carries the driver-info region (bytes 0x4620..0x48BC) that is cleared and reset, the live AI-driver slots, and the recalculated property slot at +0x48AC.

state_machines.name: GearSelection
transitions: Gear-input flag ladder at +0x1FBC..+0x20C4 selects reverse/gears 1..6 when the ladder enable byte at +0x2428 is nonzero; no flag leaves UNSELECTED (-2).
Neutral override at +0x20F0 == 0 and global byte_7D1370 == 1 force NEUTRAL (0) when the ladder is still UNSELECTED.
Gear-output slots outside the ladder (0x20F0 != 0) force the highest gear value 7.

interfaces.name: ICollisionNormalProvider
interfaces.purpose: Provide the oriented collision normal for a query position against the spatial-grid collision features.

interfaces.name: IVehicleInputProcessor
interfaces.purpose: Produce per-frame smoothed control outputs (steering, throttle, brake, clutch, handbrake) and a gear selection from raw input state.

interfaces.name: IVehiclePropertySetter
interfaces.purpose: Set a single vehicle property/state dword (this[4651]) and return the written value.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionNormalOutputConvention
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must write the normalized collision normal into the caller output vector a3 as { -(v8*v6), v8, -(v8*v7) } with v8 = 1/sqrt(v7*v7 + v6*v6 + 1.0) derived from the feature plane coefficients, and return the spatial-grid query result (feature pointer or NULL).

compatibility_contracts.name: VehicleInputSmoothingOutputOrder
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must emit the smoothed control outputs through output pointers in the order a3=steering, a4=throttle, a5=brake, a6=clutch, a7=handbrake, a8=gear, with throttle/brake/clutch/handbrake clamped to the [0,1] float range and the gear output in {-2..7} with the neutral override honoring global byte_7D1370.

compatibility_contracts.name: DriverInfoClearSentinels
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement clearing the vehicle driver-info region must zero the byte fields at 0x4620/0x4660/0x4678/0x46B8/0x46F8/0x4708/0x4714/0x4794, write -1 into dwords 0x4710/0x4898/0x489C/0x48A0/0x48A4/0x48A8, 0 into 0x48AC/0x48B8, -8388609 into 0x48B4 and 11 into 0x48BC.

compatibility_contracts.name: CollisionNodeFreePoolProtocol
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement reusing collision nodes must push drained nodes onto the global free pool through dword_8AB700 (head), dword_8AB704 (tail), dword_8AB708 (used when the pool is empty) and increment dword_8AB70C (count).

unresolved: The layout of the feature plane returned by SpatialGridQuery (result[0..4]) is not enumerated as packet fields (CollisionNormalFromFeature).
dbl_59E420 is read by CollisionNormalFromFeature but does not appear by name in the decompiled arithmetic; the 1.0 normalization constant is the only plausible consumer -- unverified.
The steering fallthrough ramp direction in VehicleInputSmoothingAndGearSelect is ambiguous: it is chosen by a decompiler FPU-status byte (v24 & 0x41) whose origin is unverifiable in the .c.

Six read-only globals (0x0059E43C, 0x0059E440, 0x0059E478, 0x0059E5FC, 0x0059E670, 0x0059E8A4) are read by VehicleInputSmoothingAndGearSelect but folded into FPU instructions by Hex-Rays; no named reference exists in the .c.
Gear-field semantics (which of +0x1FBC/+0x1FE8/+0x2014/+0x2040/+0x206C/+0x2098/+0x20C4 maps to which gear) come from DERIVED fill naming, not from the .c.
The raw decompiled body of VehiclePhysicsVelocityAngularVelocityIntegrator is truncated in the packet; exact ordering and FPU/long-double comparison semantics are not recoverable.
The branching meaning of the guard at +0x50 (contact-point count <= 1) versus the multi-vehicle network contact-force path is inferred from prior analysis.

The roles of the integration constants dbl_59E420/59E430/59E880/59ED50/59F038/59F040/59F048/59F050/59F058 and dword_8AB710 in the integrator are not pinned down; the step-size parameter value is absent from the packet.
The meaning of the collision node flags byte at obj+0x8 is unknown; no operation consumes it in CollisionBroadphaseBuilder.
The semantics of the sub_490D00 partitioning step and the argument 0 to DoublyLinkedListAppend in CollisionBroadphaseBuilder are unknown.
The concrete target offsets written by ClampedFloatSetter_1de0/ArithmeticComparison_20d0 in TrackPhysicsParameterInit profiles 2 and 3 are not evidenced (writes happen inside the callees).
The per-wheel loop base this+0x4258 used by profiles 2 and 3 is not present in the packet field list, so its element offsets cannot be tied to evidence refs.

The physical meaning of each TrackEnvironmentManager parameter slot (grip, wear, temperature, etc.) is not deterministically evidenced; only that they are clamped track-environment physics parameters.
flt_5ACD0C and dword_8AB700 are read by ProcessCollisionObjectLists but absent from the raw source text; flt_5ACD0C may back the +/-0.02 tolerance literal but that link is unconfirmed.
Only the first of the four 16-byte sub-list records (this+0x70/0x74/0x78/0x7C) has packet field evidence; records 2-4 are un-evidenced.
The DrainCollisionListsToFreePool reset loop also zeroes a parallel per-sub-list metadata array with no packet field evidence.
Collision node field +0xC is listed in the packet but never read by FilterCollisionListNodes; global dbl_5ACD30 is read but absent from the raw text (the 2.5 distance bound is a literal).
The object type and semantic purpose of the sentinel 0/-1 blocks and the config block this[617..623] = 4/2/2/0/0/0/0 in CarPhysicsStateInitializer are not established by this packet.
The sub-list allocated via ConditionalArrayAlloc/ListAppendWithSubListGeneration in CarPhysicsStateInitializer is not referenced again in that function; its disposition is unknown.
The semantic labels for tire-usage event ids 26 (in use) vs 27 (discarded) come from existing-analysis prose, not from the raw source.
The ABI lead name Vehicle_Audio_Event_Dispatch conflicts with the tire-usage interpretation of EncodeQualifyingTireUsage; the legacy lead is unconfirmed.
The non-qualifying return path of EncodeQualifyingTireUsage reads an uninitialized register, so the returned value there is undefined.
The +0x48A4/+0x48A8 slot markers and the -1 sentinel semantics (invalid/uninitialised) in ResetVehicleForReinit are DERIVED from the unconditional reset context.
The final reset call on dword_8ACEE0 in ResetVehicleForReinit targets an address not present in the packet's callee list, so it is described without naming the target.
The semantic meaning of the unnamed F1CVehicle driver-info fields (0x46B8, 0x46F8, 0x4708, 0x4710, 0x4898, 0x48A0, 0x48A8, 0x48AC, 0x48B0, 0x48B4, 0x48B8, 0x48BC) is not recoverable from this packet.
The recalc writer of field 0x48AC (noted by existing analysis as recalculated every frame, so external pokes do not persist) is not evidenced by this packet.
